promptSet.description:
AnyDoc: PDF to Clean Markdown Parser – Stop Feeding Raw PDFs to AI: AnyDoc Markdown Converter

Raw PDFs result in messy OCR errors, broken tables, and lost formatting when fed to LLMs. AnyDoc converts 14+ document formats into pristine Markdown, preserving tables, charts, financial sheets, and nested hierarchies.

Built for knowledge workers, tech operators, and fast-paced teams, AnyDoc: PDF to Clean Markdown Parser removes administrative bottlenecks, automates high-frequency routines, and maximizes daily output.

Key Features:
• Run AnyDoc on your target PDF file: anydoc convert input.pdf --format markdown.
• Open the generated .md file and inspect the table formatting.
• Feed the clean markdown context into Claude or ChatGPT for hallucination-free analysis.
• Perfect GFM Markdown table with exact column alignment and parsed financial indicators.

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/
Instagram Breakdown: https://www.instagram.com/p/DcJKpvfzUQX/
